description: Numerical-symbolic theorem connecting F.1 leading-order Q_β formula to the spectral-sequence decomposition. F.1 (rational in q) and explicit chirality residue (transcendental via Vol(6_1)) cannot match exactly; F.1 captures the LEADING q-rational approximation. The 0.4% gap is the order at which Vol(6_1) deviates from its q-rational approximation.
verdict: F.1's |h(h-2)/2|/(q(q-1)) is rational in q; the spectral chirality residue m_e·Vol(6_1)·|(q;q)_3| is transcendental (Vol(6_1) ≈ 3.164 is a hyperbolic volume).  The 1.22 ratio shows F.1 absorbs the chirality to leading-order q-rational; it cannot match exactly without an additional q-rational correction term.
